description:

demo:
# Retrieval-by-Dependency demo: transitive closure with cycle detection + pinning.
GRAPH={"app":["libA","dataX"],"libA":["libB","libA2"],"libB":[],"libA2":["libB"],
       "dataX":[],"loop1":["loop2"],"loop2":["loop1"]}
PINS={"libA":"1.4.2","libB":"0.9.1","libA2":"2.0.0","dataX":"sha256:abc"}
def closure(root):
    seen=set(); stack=[root]
    while stack:
        n=stack.pop()
        if n in seen: continue
        seen.add(n); stack.extend(GRAPH.get(n,[]))
    seen.discard(root); return sorted(seen)
deps=closure("app")
print("dependencies:",deps)
print("pins:",{d:PINS.get(d,"unpinned!") for d in deps})
